strings.en: If I'm doing this, I'm going to win!
I'll show you the Gunstriker's power!
The best defense is a good offense!
Here we go, Gunstriker!
Here it comes...!
With this Gunstriker Frame!
I'll have to outshine Raul!
All right, here I come!
I'm making the first move!
This is the Gunstriker Frame's range!
All right, I can strike first!
With this Excellence, I can beat that tactic!
Jua-Mu,/　I'll make you feel the power/　of the Gunstriker Frame!
Jua-Mu! I'll make you feel the/　Gunstriker's power all over again!
I'll hold that unit back with the Gunstriker!
I'll hold off that Raftclans!
Here I come, Karo-Ran!
Karo-Ran, let's fight fair and square!
With our Time Flow Engine,/　we'll stop your ambitions!
Gu-Landon!/　I'll show you the power of the flow of time!
I don't care who you are, if you get in our way!
You came out because you're confident in your skill...!
I'm confident in a shootout too!
If you're here to scout the market, you'll get burned!
I don't have time to deal with you!
We have to break through this area fast...!
Gadisword's ace...! I can't let my guard down!
To stop Herluga,/　I have to take down that Gyanonia!
Do you seriously think you can make/　the Cross Gate your own?!
If I can pull the Florarga away from the Cross Gate...!
Something that big.../　makes an easy target, Debudedabide!
Like I'd flinch at its tricks!
If it's unmanned, I won't hold back!
No life signs...!
If it's a Zovorg unit, I can smash it/　without a second thought!
It doesn't matter what you control!
I'll smash that monster to pieces!
Here I come, Crystal Dragoon!
Go haunt a haunted house or something!
Skull Knight, whatever you're scheming!
Isn't going around destroying the intelligent life/　of this universe the inefficient thing?!
XN-L! Go meet the same fate/　as Dark Brain and Duminas!
How many times do you have to come back?!
We've got your data, you know!
Ever heard that knowing when to quit is key?!
The Earth Sphere isn't so soft/　that you can make easy money!
Just because you've got plenty of funding...!
Get out of the Earth Sphere, all of you!
Like I'd let Golaikunru's lackeys go!
With that, even if my aim's a little off!
A Thick Cylinder ahead!
Target: Thick Cylinder!
Here I come, Big Shoulder!
I'll take that Big Shoulder!
Here I come, White Horn!
Target: White Horn!
We've got Gadisword's unit data too, you know!
Cupid confirmed! Here I go!
A Gasbra. I won't let it!
A mass-produced Leonysis... Here I go!
We can't leave even one Lamaris!
With the Gunstriker, a Lamaris is nothing!
Disappear, Lamaris!
I have to take care of the Kaana Type quick!
I won't let you, Lamaris Kaana!
Kaana Type confirmed! Here I go!
No matter what kind of Lamaris, I'll wipe it out here!
An Ida Type... It's more than twice as creepy!
I have to get the Ares Geist out of there!
I can't just do nothing!
Okay, here we go!
Starting over!
Time to strike back!
I've still got it locked!
You left an opening!
You're not getting away!
You're still over there!
I-I'm beaten?! No way!
Kyaaah!!
Not yet!/　As long as the Time Turbine turns, I can fight!
I-I'm the type who doesn't give up easily,/　you know. Not at all!
Hang in there a little longer, Gunstriker!
Ugh, it's creaking all over...!
I'll get through a pinch like this!
Even with such a sturdy frame,/　it took this much damage...!
Aah! A direct hit?!
Persistence alone doesn't decide a fight...!
Is that thing stronger than a Knight...?!
Not yet...!/　I'll show you a small business's true potential!
I-If this unit gets painted red,/　it'll clash with Raul's...!
E-Even if it's using the Cross Gate,/　to get beaten this one-sidedly...!
That laugh really ticks me off...!!
I can't let it keep laughing at me...!
I took it, Crystal Dragoon!
Getting exterminated by a dragon? No way!
I-Isn't it even stronger/　than Debudedabide?!
Our flow of time.../　I won't let you stop it!
Ugh, it's stronger than the Raftclans...!
Was the Geios Series/　always this strong...?!
Ugh... I can't let a Raftclans/　destroy the Time Flow Engine...!
I can't lose this frame/　in a fight with the Fury!
...There aren't as many warnings as I thought.
I shouldn't have left out the shield...!
Like I'd back down over this!
So it's evenly matched with us...!
Ow! You got me!
Damage check... The Time Flow Engine's okay.
Ngh, its mobility isn't that different/　from the Striker Frame's!
Jua-Mu, I won't let you do any more!
Karo-Ran's not someone/　you can read that easily...!
You're battle-hardened, Iradoya...!
You got me, Gomoudokka!
Reggiane,/　I'm not here to entertain you!
I can't let Herluga use/　the Cross Gate any more...!
It's too early to gloat, Debudedabide!
I can't underestimate/　the Crystal Dragoon's quickness...!
You move pretty flexibly for a bag of bones!
Th-That thing/　might be stronger than Dark Brain...!
Ngh! And I've fought it so many times!
The Raftclans really is a pain...!
...Of course the Fury are targeting me!/　That's exactly why I have to respond properly!
If I'm struggling against the Lamaris,/　that's no good...!
To be pushed this far by a Kaana Type...!
Ngh...!/　Its power's on a whole other level from the Kaana Type!
I've given Mizuho more work...
I couldn't dodge that.../　I'm so pathetic.
This is a sturdy frame, you know.
The damage is... what you'd call a scratch.
If I had a shield, I could've blocked it all, but...
At this rate, Raul's going to laugh at me.
Guess my concentration slipped...!
Jua-Mu, that's not enough/　to break the Gunstriker!
Karo-Ran... He's not going to be easy...!
It's too early to call yourself Emperor!
Iradoya... Is he trying to provoke me...?
Looks like he's not here just for fun...!
Ngh, is that the wisdom of age?
The Cross Gate aside,/　the Florarga must have its limits...!
I don't understand these attacks,/　but I have to avoid a direct hit...!
Crystal Dragoon... It's fast, all right.
That didn't work, Skull Knight!
I took it, XN-L!
I need to update that unit's data...!
As expected, the Geios Series is a cut/　above other mass-produced units.
Getting hit by a Lamaris...
I have to be careful not to get/　too close to the Ida Type...!
Against a Raftclans, I guess I can't/　expect to come out without a scratch...!
Not that easily!
Just as I read it!
I'm not going to be a target!
Don't think I'm an easy opponent!
You can't hit me, Jua-Mu!
Too bad, Karo-Ran!
Too naive, Gu-Landon!
I'm not falling for your bait, Iradoya!
It's no use, Gomoudokka!
I won't lose in speed or in youth!
That's meaningless, Herluga!
You can't hit me, Crystal Dragoon!
So what, Skull Knight?!
Where were you looking, XN-L?!
With all the data we have, it's easy to deal with!
Even the Geios Series is no match/　for me when I have the data!
That's right, target me!
Not to some Lamaris!
There was no point in you combining!
Even with a Raftclans targeting me, see?
It's faster than before, but I can handle it!
This frame's actually pretty light, you know.
Nice response, Gunstriker!
Let's keep it up!
Me and the Excellence can handle this easily!
You underestimated this frame, Jua-Mu.
Is that all the show you've got?
That's nothing!
I don't even need to dodge that!
That sort of thing won't work on me.
It's no use!
I misjudged that...!
That was careless of me...!
No usable weapons left...!
Ngh, I lost sight of it!
I can't believe this frame can't keep up...!
I'll have to change position...!
Gotta handle backup too!
I'll back you up with the Excellence!
One more push, right here!
I'll make the most of this chance!
Raul, leave the rest to me!
Twins in the same frame--of course we're in sync!
Excellence Combination!
Despinis, leave the rest to me!
Backing up Granteed!
Lieutenant Calvina, I'll support you!
Akimi, I'll lend a hand!
Akemi, I've got your back!
The Excellence can take it!
Like I'd let you!
This frame is tough, you know!
I'll protect you!
Despinis, don't push yourself!
I'll protect Granteed!
Lieutenant Calvina, please fall back!
Twins have to stick together!
Here's my chance!
I won't miss my chance to attack!
I'll hit you, just watch!
There!
Take this!
Missile, fire!
Guidance Mine, fire!
I've got weapons like this, too!
Guidance Mine!
With the Gatling Beam Gun!
I'll fill you full of holes!
Target locked!
Go down!
I've got you in my sights!
Fire!
Boost on!
These claws hurt, you know!
Assault!
Crusher Arm!
Hyaah!
Go!!
Heat Knife!
Taaah!!
Take this!
Off you goooo!!
I'll finish it with the knife!
I'll slice you up!
Spike Plate, set!
There!
Spike Plate, deploy!
That'll pin you down!
This is the real one!
Go down!!
Firing at maximum output!
Goooooo!!
The flow of time... I'll seize that one instant!
Gun Fairy, purge!
Floating Tank Mode!
Time for my trump card!
Go, Gun Fairy!
Mode change!
Pincer attack!
Eeeyaaah!!
Gigant!
Busterrr!!
Aaarm!!
Craaash!!
The Time Flow Engine.../　a reassuring, yet dangerous power.
Haaaaah!!
This is it! Finishing bloooow!!
A combo of Striker and Gunner!
